question: In a laboratory experiment, a Zener voltage regulator circuit utilizes a $9.0 \text{ V}$ Zener diode, a variable DC voltage source $V_i$, and a series resistor $R_s = 200 \text{ } \Omega$. A fixed load resistor $R_L = 1 \text{ k}\Omega$ is connected. If the Zener diode requires a minimum 'knee' current of $3 \text{ mA}$ to reliably sustain the avalanche breakdown, calculate the minimum input voltage $V_{i(min)}$ required to keep the load voltage strictly regulated at $9.0 \text{ V}$.
